title: GEDRoots Atlas: a country
description: What genealogy records a country kept, from when to when, who may read them, and the legal age at marriage. Format 1.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or `generic` for the countries without a file. Also the file name.

names.description: Names of the country found in places, in any language. Compared without case or accents.

marriage_age.description: Minimum age at marriage by period. The first period containing the year applies.

until.description: Year the next rule starts (excluded); open when absent.

local_name.description: Name in the country, as archives call it.

goals.description: What the record helps to find. `parents`: the parents of a person whose parents are unknown.

online_until.description: Last year that archives usually put online.

index.description: An index of other records: suggested only when the period is three years or more.

public_after.description: Years after which a record is open to everyone, for every goal or by goal (`parents` uses `birth`).

years.description: Years of the record when it was not kept every year (census years), in order.

extends_by.description: Years to add after the event (a probate record follows the death).

sex.description: Only for people of this sex.

born.description: Only for people born in these years (included).

offset.description: With `born`: the record's year is the birth year plus this.
